text:
Writer Workshops (Annex Building)
Do you like to write or have you ever thought about writing? Well, we have something new starting this coming Saturday. It’s called the Writer Workshop. Jared Pearson (Rogue River) started writing in July 2022 and published three books in “The Wizard’s Houseleek” series ( Illusion, Conjuration, Restoration). He will be teaching writer workshops in the Annex building on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of each month from 5pm-6:30pm. Each week will be a different subject when it comes to writing. Subject content will be going over the hardest thing about writing, how to write, fundamentals of writing, where and how to start, self motivation, scheduling and the most important, what to write. Be sure to bring your pen and notebook or laptop. Please call our front desk 541-582-0609 for more information or questions.
Public · Hosted by Rogue River Community Center
